//: Copy to `config.local.json`, which is not committed because these paths and modes differ per machine.
//skillTargets: Extra directories to install `skills/` into. A leading `~` is expanded, and the parent
directory has to already exist. Claude and Codex are handled automatically wherever their
CLI is on PATH, so this is for anything else that reads a directory of skill directories.
mode `link` (the default) symlinks, so edits in `skills/` are live everywhere.
mode `copy` writes real files, for a host that ships the directory somewhere this machine's
paths cannot reach. brain is the case that needs it: its box materializer recreates a
symlink verbatim, so an absolute link into ~/dotfiles dangles inside a VM or container
guest. A copy survives. Re-run initialize.js to refresh it.
